description: This file defines a FastAPI router for managing doctor profiles, including CRUD operations with role-based access control. It maps MongoDB documents to data models, and enforces permissions for actions like create, update, view, and delete.

classes.name: Doctor
classes.description: Data model representing a doctor's profile, including fields like id, user_id, specialty, and bio.

classes.name: DoctorCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a new doctor profile, includes user_id, specialty, bio.

classes.name: DoctorUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating a doctor profile with optional fields.

methods.name: Doctor _doctor_from_doc(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Transforms a MongoDB document into a Doctor model instance.

methods.name: None _assert_doctor_owner_or_admin(doc: Dict[str, Any], user_claims: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to act on a specific doctor document.

methods.name: List[Doctor] list_doctors(_: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict))
methods.description: Returns a list of all doctor profiles, accessible to authenticated users.

methods.name: Doctor create_doctor( payload: DoctorCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
methods.description: Creates a new doctor profile with RBAC enforcement.

methods.name: Doctor get_doctor( doctor_id: str = Path(..., description="Doctor document id"), _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific doctor profile by ID.

methods.name: Doctor update_doctor( doctor_id: str, payload: DoctorUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
methods.description: Updates a doctor profile if the user has permissions.

methods.name: None delete_doctor( doctor_id: str, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required_strict(["admin"])), )
methods.description: Deletes a doctor profile, admin only.

ctags.name: _assert_doctor_owner_or_admin
ctags.pattern: /^async def _assert_doctor_owner_or_admin(doc: Dict[str, Any], user_claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> Non/

ctags.name: create_doctor
ctags.signature: ( payload: DoctorCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )

ctags.name: get_doctor
ctags.signature: ( doctor_id: str = Path(..., description="Doctor document id"), _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )

ctags.name: list_doctors
ctags.pattern: /^async def list_doctors(_: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict)) -> List[Doctor]:$/

ctags.name: update_doctor
ctags.signature: ( doctor_id: str, payload: DoctorUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict), )
